semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Performance evaluation directly relates to performance engineering, as it involves assessing and measuring the capabilities and efficiencies of systems, which is a key aspect of performance engineering.

parent_domains.justification: Engineering is a broad field that includes performance engineering as a sub-domain. It encompasses the application of scientific principles to design and build systems.

Software engineering includes performance engineering as it involves designing software with optimal performance as a criteria. Performance engineering ensures that software meets performance requirements, which is an aspect of software engineering.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Performance engineering is heavily integrated into software engineering, as it specifically focuses on ensuring that software performs efficiently and optimally, making software engineering the closest parent domain.

child_domains.justification: Benchmark design involves creating tests that specifically measure performance, aligning with the goals of performance engineering to evaluate and improve system efficiency.
Evaluation methods involve techniques and procedures used to assess performance, directly contributing to performance engineering.
Similarly, evaluation techniques are specific strategies employed to measure performance, which is a critical component of performance engineering.
Evaluation metrics are standards or measures used in performance assessments, integral to performance engineering.
These involve systematic approaches to evaluating performance, key to performance engineering.

closest_child_domain.justification: Evaluation methods are specific procedures or approaches used to assess performance, directly aligning with the primary focus of performance engineering to enhance and ensure system efficiency.

sibling_domains.justification: Software reliability engineering also falls under software engineering and is concerned with ensuring software is reliable over time, which is related but distinct from performance engineering.
Algorithm engineering focuses on the design and analysis of algorithms for efficiency, which complements the goals of performance engineering in optimizing software.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Software reliability engineering is the closest sibling domain as both it and performance engineering are focused on ensuring different quality aspects (reliability and performance) of software systems within the broader scope of software engineering.

unrelated_domains.justification: Operations research focuses on decision-making and optimal resource usage, which is broader and not directly linked to the core focus of performance engineering.
Cognitive engineering deals with the interactions between humans and machines, a concept not directly tied to performance metrics or optimization.
Industrial optimization relates to physical and process efficiencies in an industrial context, which is distinct from the software focus of performance engineering.
Program analysis involves studying and analyzing program code for correctness, a focus different from performance optimization.
Performative prediction is concerned with forecasting outcomes and does not directly address system performance enhancements.
Optimization and training relate more to machine learning models rather than the holistic performance of software systems.
This domain involves the study and application of electricity and electromagnetism, unrelated to software performance optimization.
While related to performance, optimisation is a broad term and not all focuses on system performance engineering.
